purpose: Keep one shopping list the household shares, so whoever shops buys what is needed.

actions.name: addItem
actions.description: Add an item to buy, with how many (one when left blank).
refuses: a quantity that is not a whole number from 1 to 99

actions.name: tickItem
actions.description: Tick this item off, or untick it if it is already ticked.
refuses: an item that does not exist

actions.name: removeItem
actions.description: Remove this item from the list.
refuses: an item that does not exist

actions.name: clearTicked
actions.description: Remove every ticked item from the list.

near_miss: a list where ticking an item deletes it, so a shopper who ticks by mistake loses it
misfits: a list each person keeps alone, so the shopper never sees what others added
